description: The photo gallery for a home — one URL per photo, in order, with the hero photo first. size full adds every size Zillow serves for each photo.

expand.description: false (default): the compact form - the headline of a record or a search row, or the answer minus photo and tour links. true: the complete response from the data API (a full record is ~17 KB). Same price either way.

size.description: full to add every image size Zillow serves (larger answer). (one of full)

name: zillow_photos
